title: Optimal tree-decompositions with bags of bounded pathwidth
summary: We show that every planar graph has a tree-decomposition with optimal width such that the subgraph induced by each bag has pathwidth at most 3. This bound is best possible, and for tree-decompositions that satisfy a certain minimality condition, we in fact give a precise description of the possible structures in each bag. Moreover, we show that the union of any $k$ bags has pathwidth $O(k)$. We also show that graphs excluding a fixed double-apex-forest minor have a tree-decomposition with optimal width such that the subgraph induced by each bag has bounded pathwidth.
